title: CVE-2026-100790 — Use-after-free in the XSLT component
summary: Affected: Mozilla Firefox, Mozilla Thunderbird Use-after-free in the XSLT component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox ESR 153.4, Thunderbird 157, Thunderbird 140.17, Thunderbird 153.4, Firefox 157, Firefox ESR 115.42, and Firefox ESR 140.17.

title: CVE-2026-95210
summary: Improper certificate validation in gnutls v3.8.13 causes the application to accept certificates containing invalid extensions.

title: CVE-2026-95209
summary: An issue in gnutls v3.8.13 causes legitimate CA certificates to be rejected, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

title: CVE-2026-95184
summary: Improper certificate validation in gnutls v3.8.13 causes the application to reject legitimate certificates for valid users, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

title: CVE-2026-89088 — Parted: parted: denial of service via heap buffer overflow during fat16 resize
summary: Affected: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 A flaw was found in parted. A heap-based buffer overflow exists in libparted's file system resizing logic when handling FAT16 volumes. By convincing a user or administrator to resize a specially crafted FAT16 file system image with malformed directory metadata, an attacker can trigger an oversized read into a fixed-size memory buffer. This issue causes memory corruption, resulting in an application crash and a denial of service (DoS).

title: CVE-2026-89085 — Parted: parted: heap-based buffer overflow via crafted fat32 filesystem image
summary: Affected: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 A flaw was found in parted. A heap-based buffer overflow can occur when processing a specially crafted FAT32 filesystem due to an integer calculation error during buffer allocation. A local attacker could exploit this by enticing a user or automated service to open a malicious filesystem image, resulting in an application crash leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or potential memory corruption.

title: CVE-2026-89059 — Resteasy-core: resteasy: iioimageprovider unbounded image decode (decompression-bomb dos)
summary: Affected: Red Hat RESTEasy, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.27.6.redhat, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4.redhat, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 for Quarkus 3, Red Hat build of Apicurio Registry 3, Red Hat build of Debezium 3, Red Hat Build of Keycloak, Red Hat Certificate System 10, Red Hat Certificate System 11 and 8 more A flaw was found in RESTEasy's IIOImageProvider, which decodes attacker-supplied image request bodies without enforcing any limit on the declared image dimensions or pixel count. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send a small crafted image declaring enormous dimensions to trigger a very large memory allocation, exhausting the JVM heap and resulting in a denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-89058 — Resteasy-core: resteasy: corsfilter reflects arbitrary origin with credentials under wildcard config
summary: Affected: Red Hat RESTEasy, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.27.6.redhat, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4.redhat, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 for Quarkus 3, Red Hat build of Apicurio Registry 3, Red Hat build of Debezium 3, Red Hat Build of Keycloak, Red Hat Certificate System 10, Red Hat Certificate System 11 and 8 more A flaw was found in RESTEasy's CorsFilter, which, when configured to allow all origins ("*"), reflects the request's Origin header back in the Access-Control-Allow-Origin response together with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. This permissive cross-origin policy allows a malicious website to make credentialed cross-origin requests and read authenticated responses from a victim's session, resulting in a loss of confidentiality.

title: CVE-2026-88648
summary: Incomplete X.509 implementation in GnuTLS v3.8.13 allows attackers controlling a subordinate Certificate Authority to bypass cross-domain PKI restrictions and issue unauthorized certificates.

title: CVE-2026-88647
summary: A hostname verification bypass in GnuTLS v3.8.13 allows attackers to circumvent the Common Name fallback mechanism and eavesdrop on communications via a crafted certificate.
